description: What Folio's windows (the main one and page windows) may ask of the system: their own title bar (drag, minimize, maximize, close), opening a page in its own window, opening web and mail links in the default browser or mail app, files in the app's own data folder for offline copies, folio:// links, the unread count on the app's icon, coming to the front, and system notifications, and checking for, installing and restarting into a new version.
